$comment: PB-27 — the VENDORED hash of every box config file a box reports (tooling/ops/boxes/post-config-manifest.sh),
read by tooling/ops/check-box-config-drift.mjs in ops-watch against platform_db.box_config_manifest.
`vendored` is the file's path inside the private corpus checkout; `sha256` is that file's hash, written ONLY by
`node tooling/ops/check-box-config-drift.mjs --refresh-vendored <corpus dir>` — never typed. A null `sha256` is
COVERAGE LOST (exit 2), never a pass — inside its box's firstDue it is KNOWN-PENDING, dated, and red again after it. The logical names are the first column of each box's
/etc/nikatru/box-manifest.files; a file a box posts that is not declared here is a finding (UNDECLARED).
`maxPostAgeHours`: the box cron runs daily, so two missed runs plus slack.
⏱ 2026-10-03 (ops-watch 37103985999). The `vendored` paths are the corpus's own byte copies of the live files, each
recorded as such in the corpus runbooks (runbooks/boxb-services.md, runbooks/boxes/hostinger.md, runbooks/ntfy.md,
runbooks/vaultwarden.md, runbooks/beszel-dozzle.md, runbooks/boxes/boxc.md). Box B's names were a placeholder
(`compose`, `override`, `tunnel`): the corpus vendors SIX Box B compose files, one per stack, and NO override, so each stack is declared
by its own name and `override` is not declared.
